covers: The command field (bits 3 to 5) and the CRC reset code (bits 6 and 7) of a WR0 write; a key is the field's own value in place in the byte, 0x00 standing for both null fields

entries.name: null command
entries.description: No command and no CRC code; the byte only sets the register pointer.
entries.behaviour: Bits 3 to 5 equal to 0 do nothing, and bits 6 and 7 equal to 0 do nothing either. Bits 0 to 2 still set the register pointer for the next control access.

entries.name: send abort
entries.description: Sends an SDLC abort sequence from the transmitter.
entries.behaviour: Acts only in SDLC mode (WR4 bits 2 and 3 zero, bits 4 and 5 equal to 2): the transmitter is loaded with eight ones as an abort and the buffer is marked empty. In any other mode the command is ignored.

entries.name: reset ext status
entries.description: Re-arms the external/status interrupt and refreshes the pin bits of RR0.
entries.behaviour: Clears the latch that froze RR0 bits 3 to 5 and the break latch, rereads DCD, CTS and sync into RR0, and clears the pending external/status interrupt. It does not clear RR0 bit 6, which CRC code 0xC0 does, and bit 7 follows the line.

entries.name: channel reset
entries.description: Resets the channel without touching most register bits.
entries.behaviour: Disables the receiver (WR3 bit 0) and transmitter (WR5 bit 3) and wait or ready (WR1 bit 7), empties the receive FIFO and clears the RR1 error bits, sets RR0 buffer empty and underrun, and raises TxD, RTS and DTR. The channel's interrupts are cleared; on channel A every interrupt of both channels goes. Other register bits keep their value.

entries.name: enable int next rx
aliases: enable int on next rx char
entries.description: Arms an interrupt on the next received character, for receive interrupt on first character mode.
entries.behaviour: Sets a flag that the next received character consumes, marking it as the one that interrupts. It matters only when WR1 bits 3 and 4 select first character, where later characters interrupt only with a special condition.

entries.name: reset tx int pending
entries.description: Clears the channel's pending transmit interrupt.
entries.behaviour: Drops the transmit interrupt request of the channel written to. It returns when the transmit buffer next goes from full to empty with WR1 bit 1 set; writing a data byte also clears it.

entries.name: error reset
entries.description: Clears the error bits of RR1.
entries.behaviour: Clears RR1 bits 4 to 7 (parity, overrun, CRC or framing, end of frame). When receive interrupt mode is first character and a framing, overrun or end of frame error was set, it also advances the receive FIFO; otherwise it recomputes the receive interrupt.

entries.name: reset highest IUS
entries.description: Releases the highest-priority interrupt under service so lower ones can interrupt again.
entries.behaviour: Only a write to channel A acts, on the whole chip, and the INT line is rechecked. On the Z80 SIO and DART a RETI seen on the daisy chain does the same. A write to channel B does nothing.

entries.name: reset rx CRC checker
entries.description: CRC reset code 1: preloads the receive CRC.
entries.behaviour: Loads the receive CRC with ones in SDLC mode and zeros otherwise; in byte-sync modes it also stops accumulation until the next character boundary re-enables it.

entries.name: reset tx underrun latch
entries.description: CRC reset code 3: clears the underrun or end of message latch, RR0 bit 6.
entries.behaviour: Accepted only in the active part of a packet, which in sync mode starts with the first data byte written after the idle pattern; otherwise it is ignored and bit 6 stays set.
